frontmatter.title: Project Atlas: Responsible Localization Toolkit
frontmatter.summary: Open-source CLI and dashboards that help product teams audit language experiences and roll out updates with confidence.

body.outcome: Adopted by 30+ civic organizations within the first quarter.

Automated governance reports aligned with EU AI Act guidance.
Community extensions for Persian, Spanish, and Arabic localization.
